1542年，阿尔瓦尔·努涅斯·卡韦萨·德瓦卡从大西洋海岸经陆路前往亚松森途中遇见瀑布。他将其称为圣玛丽亚瀑布，但瓜拉尼语名称流传下来。耶稣会传教聚落后来出现在更广阔的河流地区，部分瓜拉尼社群被集中到其中。河流与森林始终是这片边疆的核心景观，原住民社会、传教士与欧洲殖民者在此相遇。

english: The Ygyatta rises on the Vilyuy Plateau and flows south to join the Vilyuy from the left. In its lower course the river winds through broad loops across a wide floodplain. Forest and meadows line its banks, while streams from the plateau feed its waters. The Vilyuy carries them eastward to the Lena, connecting this inland basin with the great rivers of northern Siberia.
simp_chinese: 伊吉亚塔河发源于维柳伊高原，向南流去，从左岸注入维柳伊河。下游河道在宽阔泛滥平原上形成许多大河曲。森林与草地沿岸分布，高原溪流汇入河中。维柳伊河将水流向东送入勒拿河，使这片内陆流域与西伯利亚北方大河相连。

english: The Yí flows west through the rolling grasslands of central Uruguay to join the Río Negro. Rising near Cerro Chato, it is a major tributary of the Negro’s left bank and belongs to the wider Uruguay River basin. Woodland follows stretches of its banks amid the open country. The river and its tributaries run through territory associated with Indigenous peoples of the Río Negro basin, including the Charrúa.
simp_chinese: 伊河向西流经乌拉圭中部起伏草原，汇入内格罗河。它发源于塞罗查托附近，是内格罗河左岸的重要支流，属于更广阔的乌拉圭河流域。开阔土地间，部分河岸生长着林木。河流及其支流穿过与内格罗河流域原住民族、包括查鲁亚人有关的地区。

english: Yibin, the seat of Xuzhou, stands at the meeting of the Min and Jinsha rivers, where their combined waters flow east as the Yangtze. The confluence placed the city at the head of a great waterway and at the junction of routes into southern Sichuan and Yunnan. Boats arriving from different valleys brought goods to its riverfront markets. In the eighteenth century, merchants increasingly used the city as a centre for exchange between Sichuan and Yunnan. The Min linked it with the Chengdu plain, while the Jinsha came down from the southwest. Its position between these waterways and the mountain roads helped make Xuzhou an important trading centre in the Qing period.
simp_chinese: 宜宾是叙州府治，坐落在岷江与金沙江汇流之处，两河合流后向东成为长江。城镇既处于大江上游的水路起点，也位于通往川南和云南道路的交汇处。来自不同河谷的船只将货物带到江岸市场。十八世纪，商人日益将这里作为川滇贸易的集散地。岷江连接成都平原，金沙江从西南而来；两条水道与山路在此汇合，使叙州成为清代重要的商贸中心。

sources.title: 宜宾市历史文化名城保护规划-说明书.pdf
sources.url: https://www.sc.gov.cn/10462/10778/10876/2023/1/16/1235a74c94284404979250f4308dabec/files/宜宾市历史文化名城保护规划-说明书.pdf

english: Yíchéng lies beside the Hàn River south of Xiāngyáng. In antiquity the city of Yān served as a secondary capital of Chǔ, visited by several of its kings. In 278 BC the Qín general Bái Qǐ captured Yān before advancing against the Chǔ capital, bringing an end to its role as a royal seat.
simp_chinese: 宜城位于襄阳以南的汉江畔。古代鄢城曾是楚国别都，几位楚王都曾到此居住。公元前278年，秦将白起攻克鄢城，随后进攻楚都，鄢作为王室别都的历史至此结束。

english: Yicheng lies where the hills of southern Shanxi meet the Fen and Hui river valleys. Its villages preserve a lively tradition of theatre performed before temples. At Fandian, a temple to the deified general Guan Yu was founded in 1505, with a stage facing the main hall across the courtyard. Its upturned eaves and graceful roof made the stage a local landmark. The temple was repaired in 1831, long after its Ming builders had completed the original hall and stage.
simp_chinese: 翼城位于晋南丘陵与汾、浍河谷交接之处，村落中有在庙前演戏的传统。樊店关帝庙于1505年创建，戏台与正殿隔院相对；飞翘的檐角和优美的屋脊使戏台格外引人注目。正殿与戏台建于明代，寺庙后来又在1831年重修。

english: Yichuan lies in the loess hills west of the Yellow River, southeast of Yan'an. The plateau is broken into smaller uplands by streams and ravines, while the great river forms the eastern boundary. At Hukou, the Yellow River narrows abruptly from a broad channel into a rocky gorge and plunges over a waterfall. A county gazetteer of 1753 compared the constricted channel to the mouth of a kettle, explaining the name Hukou. The falls mark one of the river's most dramatic passages through the plateau.
simp_chinese: 宜川位于延安东南、黄河以西的黄土丘陵。溪流与沟谷将台塬分割成小块高地，东面的黄河则形成地域边界。在壶口，宽阔河道骤然收束于岩石峡槽，河水奔泻成瀑。1753年的县志将狭窄水道比作壶口，由此解释瀑布名称；这里是黄河穿越高原最壮观的一段。

english: Yichun is an ancient county seat in western Jiangxi and the centre of Yuanzhou. Tradition connects its name, meaning “pleasant spring”, with a nearby spring whose waters were cool in summer and warm in winter. The Yuan governed the district as Yuanzhou Circuit; in 1369 the Ming changed it to Yuanzhou Prefecture, still seated at Yichun. The Xiujiang postal station was built by a county magistrate during the Hongwu reign and later moved to the eastern gate, serving the roads that connected the town with neighbouring counties.
simp_chinese: 宜春是江西西部的古县城，也是袁州治所。相传城旁泉水夏凉冬暖，饮之宜人，县名因此取意于春。元代以此为袁州路治所，明朝于1369年改设袁州府，府治仍在宜春。洪武年间，知县兴建秀江驿，后来驿站迁至东门，为往来邻县道路上的旅人服务。

english:
Yidinjdji belongs to the tropical forest country of northeastern Australia. Yidiny lands have been described around the Barron River and the lowland rainforests near present-day Cairns, extending inland towards Mount Hypipamee. Rivers, forests and uplands offered different resources as the seasons changed.

The Yidiny spoke their own language and consisted of several clans with ties to particular areas. Relationships with neighbouring peoples connected communities beyond their immediate country. Knowledge of plants, paths and seasonal conditions was part of an inherited relationship with the rainforest landscape.
simp_chinese:
伊丁吉属于澳大利亚东北部的热带森林地区。据记述，伊丁吉人的土地包括今凯恩斯附近的巴伦河及低地雨林，并向内陆延伸至希皮帕米山一带。河流、森林和高地随季节提供不同资源。

伊丁吉人使用自己的语言，由与不同地方相联系的多个氏族组成。与邻近族群的关系，使社群之间的联系超越各自的土地范围。对植物、路径和季节变化的了解，是人们代代相传的雨林生活知识的一部分。

english: Yídū lies near the meeting of the Qīng River and the Yangtze, below the gorges of western Húběi. Known in Hàn times as Yídào, it served as the seat of Yídū commandery. The river brought the town into the shifting political and military world of the Three Kingdoms, when control of the gorge routes was fiercely contested.
simp_chinese: 宜都位于清江与长江交汇附近，地处湖北西部峡谷下游。汉代此地称夷道，曾为宜都郡治所。三国时期，峡江航路屡遭争夺，这座临江城镇也卷入其间的政局与战争。

english: Yidu was the county seat of Qingzhou in central Shandong, a city with a long history as an administrative and commercial centre. East of its walls, the Zhaode quarter housed a Muslim community and the Zhenjiao Mosque. The mosque was rebuilt under the Yuan by descendants of Sayyid Ajall Shams al-Din, repaired by local officials in the Ming and enlarged again under the Qing. Its halls and courtyards stand as a reminder of the community's lasting place in the city.
simp_chinese: 益都是山东中部青州的附郭县，青州城长期是地方行政和商业中心。城东昭德一带有穆斯林聚居，真教寺便坐落于此。元代赛典赤·赡思丁的后裔重建寺院，明代地方官又加修葺，清代再次扩建。殿堂与院落见证了这个社群在城中延续多代的生活。

english: Yifeng stood at the seat of Luanzhou near the Luan River. The county’s name came from a community moved here from central Hebei under the Liao. In the Yuan period it briefly lost its separate status, was restored, and received land from neighbouring counties. The early Ming again absorbed Yifeng into Luanzhou in 1369, leaving the prefecture to govern the district directly.
simp_chinese: 义丰位于滦河附近，与滦州同治。辽代将河北中部的居民迁至此地，沿用原籍义丰之名设县。元代义丰一度被省，旋即恢复，又接纳邻县部分土地。明洪武二年（1369年），义丰再次并入滦州，州直接治理当地。

english:
Yihuang lies among the hills of eastern Jiangxi, where the Yi and Huang rivers feed the Fu. The county is known for its theatre, which drew on melodies and performance traditions from several parts of China. Local stages and travelling companies made its actors familiar throughout the surrounding river country.

In the Ming, the general Tan Lun brought a Haiyan opera troupe home from Zhejiang. Its music mingled with the Yiyang style and local song, contributing to a distinctive Yihuang tradition. Performers were among the first to stage the plays of Tang Xianzu. In 1602 Tang wrote an inscription for their temple to the theatrical patron Qingyuan, recording the esteem in which the actors held their craft.
simp_chinese:
宜黄位于江西东部丘陵中，宜水、黄水汇入抚河水系。这里以戏曲著称，地方舞台与巡演戏班吸收各地声腔，使宜黄伶人在周围河谷广为人知。

明代将领谭纶从浙江带回海盐腔戏班，外来曲调与当地弋阳腔、民间音乐相互影响，形成独特的宜黄戏曲传统。宜黄演员率先搬演汤显祖的剧作。1602年，汤显祖为伶人奉祀戏神清源的庙宇撰记，留下他们敬重技艺的见证。

english: Yiiji country lies around Cambridge Gulf and the river country of the northeastern Kimberley. Yiiji people are among the groups associated with the Forrest River area, alongside Miwa and Kwini neighbours. Their lands include tidal waters, river valleys and ranges, and their relationships with neighbouring peoples crossed the varied country between the coast and inland.
simp_chinese: 伊吉地区位于金伯利东北部的剑桥湾与河流地带。伊吉人与米瓦、奎尼邻居同属于福雷斯特河一带的群体。当地土地包括潮汐水域、河谷和山岭，居民与邻居的关系跨越海岸和内陆之间多样的地形。

english: Yijin was a fortified crossing on the plain south of the northern frontier. In 959 the Later Zhou recovered Yijin Pass from the Khitan and established Bazhou here. The county of Yijin later shared the prefectural seat, but was absorbed into Bazhou in the early Ming. The old pass recalls the time when this low, watery country stood close to the contested boundary between the Song and Liao states.
simp_chinese: 益津是北方边境以南平原上的关隘。后周于959年从契丹收复益津关，在此设霸州；益津县后来与州同治，明初并入霸州。旧关让人想起这片水网低地曾靠近宋辽争夺的边界。

english: Yijun lies in the hills south of Fuzhou, where valleys cut through the wooded edge of the Loess Plateau. The old county was connected with Yuhua Palace, a Tang retreat built in a mountain valley. The palace was later converted into a Buddhist temple, where the monk Xuanzang worked on translations of scriptures. The county seat itself moved over time, and the Yuan transferred Yijun from the abolished Fangzhou to Fuzhou. It remained under Fuzhou through the Ming and Qing.
simp_chinese: 宜君位于鄜州以南的丘陵，河谷穿过黄土高原边缘的林地。旧县与山谷中的唐代避暑宫玉华宫有关；宫殿后来改为佛寺，僧人玄奘曾在此译经。县治历经迁移，元代废坊州后，宜君改属鄜州，明清时期仍归鄜州管辖。

english: Yilaha lies on the Laolai River, a tributary of the Nemer in the Nen basin. In Qing times a relay post called Yilahachi stood along the river, on an important route between the garrisons at Mergen and Heilongjiang and the lands to the south. Post households supplied transport and carried official communications along this frontier road. The valley's waters flow south to the Nemer and then west to the Nen, connecting the station country with the larger river system.
simp_chinese: 伊拉哈位于老莱河畔，这条河经讷谟尔河流入嫩江。清代此处设伊拉喀池站，是墨尔根城、黑龙江城通往南方的重要驿路上的一站。站户为官府提供交通工具，沿边疆道路传递公文。老莱河向南注入讷谟尔河，再向西汇入嫩江，使驿站所在的河谷与更大的水系相连。

english: Yilba is a name associated with an Aboriginal language variety of inland north Queensland and the wider Biri group. West of the coastal ranges, the landscape includes dry plains, woodland and intermittent creeks. The Belyando and Burdekin rivers connect much of this inland country.
simp_chinese: 伊尔巴是与昆士兰北部内陆一种原住民语言变体有关的名称，属于更广泛的比里语群。海岸山脉以西分布着干旱平原、林地和间歇性溪流。贝利安多河与伯德金河连接这片内陆地区的广大部分。

english: Yiliang lies east of Kunming in the upper Nanpan River country, where mountain ranges alternate with cultivated basins. An older settlement was built between the hills by a local Luo leader and was known as Luopoulong. The Yuan established Yiliang as a prefecture in 1276, then made it a county in 1284; the Ming and Qing retained it under Yunnan Prefecture. In the early Ming, the general Mu Ying had Shengfeng Bridge built over the western watercourse, giving the town its first stone bridge.
simp_chinese: 宜良位于昆明以东的南盘江上游，山地与耕作盆地交错。当地罗氏首领曾在两山之间筑城，称罗裒笼。元朝于1276年设宜良州，1284年降为县，明清时期属云南府。明初沐英在城中西门河上修建胜峰桥，为宜良最早的石桥。

english: Yílíng stands where the Yangtze emerges from the mountain gorges into the plains of central Húběi. The site was an important western frontier of Chǔ and later served as a seat of successive districts and prefectures. In 1376 the Míng renamed Xiá Prefecture as Yílíng Prefecture, administering Yídū, Chángyáng, and Yuǎn’ān from its seat here.
simp_chinese: 夷陵位于长江出峡、进入湖北中部平原之处。古代这里是楚国西部要地，后来历为郡、县、州治。明洪武九年（1376年），峡州改为夷陵州，以夷陵为治所，辖宜都、长阳、远安三县。

english: Yilong is a county in the hills of northeastern Sichuan, within the old territory of Shunqing. In 1375 the Ming government incorporated it into Pengzhou, restoring it as a separate county five years later. The wars at the end of the Ming and beginning of the Qing left the district sparsely inhabited. Officials offered abandoned land to settlers, and later measures encouraged migrants to cultivate Sichuan's vacant fields. Among those who made homes in Yilong were Hakka families from other parts of China.
simp_chinese: 仪陇是四川东北丘陵中的县邑，旧属顺庆。明洪武八年（1375）仪陇并入蓬州，五年后复置。明末清初战乱使当地人口稀少，官府招徕移民，给予荒地，后来又采取措施鼓励垦殖四川的闲田。来自中国其他地区的客家家庭，也在仪陇定居下来。

english: Yílún was the seat of Dānzhōu in northwestern Hainan, near the river from which the older name Yìlún was taken. Under the Song it also governed Chānghuà Military Prefecture. The Ming restored the name Dānzhōu, with Yílún as one of its counties, but abolished the county in 1440 and placed its households directly under the zhou. In the early fifteenth century the Li chief Wáng Xiányòu helped persuade other communities to submit to the Ming and was appointed deputy prefect of Dānzhōu.
simp_chinese: 宜伦是海南西北部儋州治所，旧名义伦，取自当地河流之名。宋代这里也是昌化军的治所。明朝恢复儋州之名，宜伦为其属县；正统五年（1440年）废县，户籍直隶儋州。十五世纪初，黎族峒首王贤祐协助招抚其他社群，获朝廷任命为儋州同知。

english: Yiman lies in the country of the Iman River, a major tributary of the Ussuri. The river rises in the Sikhote-Alin and flows west through forested valleys before meeting the Ussuri. Maps of the eighteenth century recorded it as Niman, while Udege communities lived in its basin and followed the streams into the surrounding hunting grounds. The confluence joins the mountain river to the broader waterway leading north toward the Amur.
simp_chinese: 尼满位于伊曼河流域。这条乌苏里江的重要支流发源于锡霍特山脉，向西流经森林河谷，汇入乌苏里江。十八世纪地图将其记作尼满，乌德盖社群居住于流域内，沿溪流进入周围猎场。河口将山间水道与向北通往黑龙江的宽阔江流连接起来。

english: Yiman country lies in the inland river and range country of central Queensland. The Yiman, also known as Iman, are associated with the Dawson River and the country around its tributaries. Their lands lie west of the Great Dividing Range, among the neighboring countries of several Aboriginal peoples.
simp_chinese: 伊曼人的土地位于昆士兰中部内陆的河流和山地。伊曼人与道森河及其支流周围地区相联系。这片土地在大分水岭以西，邻近几个其他原住民族的地区。

english: Yimen lies in the mountains west of Dian Lake, where copper-bearing ground has long attracted miners. A Ming gazetteer records a copper levy here, placing the district among Yunnan's sources of the metal. Its administrative and military centres once stood apart: the county seat remained at Jiuxian, while a Ming garrison occupied a fortified town at Guishan. In 1574 the governor obtained permission to move the county seat to Guishan, bringing civil and military government together in one town.
simp_chinese: 易门位于滇池以西的山地，蕴藏铜矿，长期有人开采。明代方志记载这里征收铜课，使易门成为云南产铜之地之一。县治与军事中心曾长期分离：县城在旧县，而明朝守御千户所设于龟山。1574年，巡抚奏请将县治迁到龟山，使地方行政与军事机构聚于一城。

english: The Yimin River flows through the Hulunbuir grasslands towards the Hailar, of which it is a tributary. Its valley crosses open steppe, with wetlands and riverbank vegetation along the watercourse. Beyond the meeting of the rivers, the Hailar flows west and becomes part of the Argun system. The river thus brings the waters of the grasslands into a basin that eventually joins the great Amur.
simp_chinese: 伊敏河流经呼伦贝尔草原，汇入海拉尔河。河谷穿过开阔草地，沿水道分布着湿地和河岸植被。两河汇合后，海拉尔河向西流去，成为额尔古纳河水系的一部分。草原的水流由此进入最终通往黑龙江的流域。

sources.title: 366233411 Research on the Impact of Water Conservancy Projects on Downstream Floodplain Wetlands-Taking Yimin River as an Example

english: Yindjibarndi country lies in the Pilbara, around the Fortescue River and the ranges to its south. The river, known to Yindjibarndi people as the Warlu, is central to their country and stories. Deep gorges and pools interrupt the dry rocky landscape, forming places with enduring cultural significance.
simp_chinese: 因吉班迪人的土地位于皮尔巴拉的福特斯丘河及其南方山岭一带。这条河被因吉班迪人称为瓦尔卢，在他们的土地与故事中占据重要地位。深峡谷和水潭分布在干旱的岩石景观中，是具有长久文化意义的地方。

english: Yingchang stood beside Lake Dali in the Mongolian grasslands. The city, also known as the Prince of Lu's city, became a refuge for the Yuan court after the loss of its capital to the Ming. Toghon Temür, the last Yuan emperor to rule China, died here in 1370. Shortly afterwards Ming forces under Li Wenzhong captured Yingchang, while his successor Ayurshiridara escaped northward toward Karakorum. The lakeside city thus figured in the struggle that followed the fall of the Yuan capital.
simp_chinese: 应昌位于蒙古草原达里湖畔，又称鲁王城。元朝失去都城后，朝廷退到这里；最后一位统治中国的元帝妥懽帖睦尔于1370年在应昌去世。不久，李文忠率明军攻克应昌，其继承者爱猷识理达腊向北逃往和林。元都陷落后的战争，使这座湖边城邑成为重要的政治舞台。

english: Yìngchéng lies on the Jianghan Plain, where deposits of gypsum and salt lie beneath the land. The district belonged to the market for Huái salt under the Qīng monopoly, and officials prohibited local salt production through much of the dynasty. Its mineral resources remained part of a landscape shaped by fields, waterways, and the nearby salt trade.
simp_chinese: 应城位于江汉平原，地下蕴藏石膏和盐。清代盐政将此地划为淮盐销售区，官府在相当长时间内禁止当地生产盐。矿藏、田野与水道共同构成这片地区的面貌。

english:
Yingdao was the seat of Daozhou on the Xiao River in southern Hunan. It was the birthplace of the Song philosopher Zhou Dunyi, whose writings helped lay the foundations of Neo-Confucian thought. The stream by his home was called Lianxi, a name later associated with the scholar himself.

At the beginning of the Ming, Daozhou became a prefecture with its seat at Yingdao. In 1376 the prefecture was reduced to a subprefecture under Yongzhou, and Yingdao County was absorbed into it. The city walls, rebuilt on the north bank of the Xiao in the early Ming, were enlarged and repaired in 1492. The local school later honoured Zhou and his disciples Cheng Hao and Cheng Yi in its shrine.
simp_chinese:
营道是湘南潇水边的道州治所，也是宋代理学家周敦颐的故乡。周敦颐的著述为后来理学的发展奠定了基础；他家乡门前的小溪称濂溪，这个名字也与他本人联系在一起。

明初道州升为府，治所在营道。1376年，道州降为永州府属州，营道县并入州治。城墙在明初于潇水北岸改筑，1492年又增修。地方学宫后来设祠，奉祀周敦颐及其弟子程颢、程颐。

english: Yingde lies on the Bei River amid the hills of northern Guangdong. The name dates to 1195, when the Southern Song raised Yingzhou to the prefecture of Yingde. Under the Yuan it became a circuit and then a smaller prefecture, absorbing the counties of Zhenyang and Hanguang in 1314. The Ming made Yingde a county in 1369. Parts of its extensive territory were later separated to form Changning County in 1569 and, together with land from Qingyuan, Fogang subprefecture in 1813.
simp_chinese: 英德位于广东北部丘陵之间，北江流经此地。1195年，南宋升英州为英德府，英德之名由此而来。元代这里先后为路、州，1314年真阳、浛洸两县并入英德州。明朝于1369年改州为县。此后，英德部分土地又被划出：1569年与邻县土地合置长宁县，1813年与清远部分土地合置佛冈厅。

english: Yinggarda country extends from the western coast around Carnarvon along the Gascoyne River and south towards the Wooramel River. Yinggarda is a Kartu language, and its speakers have long maintained connections across this coastal and river country. The Baiyungu, Maia and Tharrkari are among their neighbours to the north, with Malgana country to the south.
simp_chinese: 英加达人的土地从卡那封周围西海岸沿加斯科因河展开，并向南延伸至沃拉梅尔河。英加达语是一种卡尔图语，其使用者长期与这片海岸和河流地区保持联系。拜云古、迈亚和塔卡里人是北方邻族，南方则是马尔加纳人的土地。

english: Yingge Cape projects from the southwestern coast of Hainan into the Gulf of Tonkin. Its waters face Vietnam across the gulf, while a dry coast lies behind the cape. During the Yongzheng reign, migrants from Qiongshan and Fujian settled nearby and made their living by fishing, giving the coastal settlement the name Yinggehai. The sea also supplied salt used and exchanged by the island’s inhabitants.
simp_chinese: 莺歌角从海南岛西南海岸伸入北部湾，隔海面向越南，背后是干燥的海岸地带。清雍正年间，琼山、福建等地移民在附近定居，以捕鱼为生，聚落取名莺歌海。海水也为岛上居民提供食盐，用于生活和交换。

english: Yingisar, whose Turkic name means “new fortress”, lies south of Kashgar on the road toward Yarkand. Its oasis fields are watered by streams from the western mountains, while the town has long been known for the work of its knife makers. After the Qing conquest of the Tarim Basin in the eighteenth century, Yingisar was counted among the eight principal southern cities where imperial officials were stationed.
simp_chinese: 英吉沙的突厥语名称意为“新城”，位于喀什以南通往叶尔羌的道路上。西方山地的溪流灌溉绿洲田地，当地刀匠制作的刀具也久负盛名。十八世纪清朝征服塔里木盆地后，英吉沙被列为南疆八大城之一，清廷在此驻派官员。

english: Yingli lies on the Yellow River where the cultivated plain meets the sands of the northwest. Under Western Xia and the Yuan the district was known as Yingli Zhou. The Ming established Ningxia Central Garrison here in 1403, giving the town the name Zhongwei, and stationed soldiers to defend the river corridor. A Confucian school was established at the garrison in 1439. The Qing retained the military post until it became a county in the Yongzheng reign.
simp_chinese: 应理位于黄河之滨，耕作平原在此与西北沙地相接。西夏和元代这里称应理州，明永乐元年后改设宁夏中卫，驻军守卫黄河通道，中卫由此得名。1439年，卫城设立儒学。清代仍沿用卫所建置，雍正年间改为县。

english: Yìngshān lies in northeastern Húběi near the passes leading toward the northern plain. Under the Suí, neighbouring Píngjìng County was absorbed into Yìngshān in 606. The county remained part of the administrative landscape of Suízhōu through the Míng and early Qīng, amid hills and valleys on the approaches between Húběi and Hénán.
simp_chinese: 应山位于湖北东北部，靠近通往北方平原的关隘。隋大业二年（606年），平靖县并入应山。明代及清初，应山仍属随州，地处鄂豫之间的丘陵和山谷地带。

english: Yīngshān lies on the southern slopes of the Dàbié Mountains, a landscape long known for tea. Records describe teas called Tuánhuáng and Qímén among the celebrated products of the Huáinán region during the Táng dynasty. Sent as tribute to the capital Cháng’ān, they connected these mountain gardens with the imperial court.
simp_chinese: 英山位于大别山南麓，山地长期以茶叶闻名。据史料记载，唐代当地的团黄、蕲门茶是淮南名茶，曾作为贡品送往长安。山中茶园由此与帝都相连。

english:
Yingshan lies in the hills of the Sichuan basin, among valleys, cultivated slopes and local waterways. Arable land occurs at different elevations, while paths and market centres connect villages with neighbouring districts. Terrain and access to water shape both production and travel.

During the Ming and Qing periods, county administration, markets and religious sites linked communities across the wider Shunqing region. Seventeenth-century warfare severely disrupted population and production in many parts of Sichuan. Later resettlement and recovery changed rural society as people rebuilt fields, homes and exchanges with neighbouring markets.
simp_chinese:
营山位于四川盆地的丘陵地带，河谷、坡地和水道构成当地乡村景观。适宜耕作的土地分布在不同高程，村落之间通过道路和集市相连；地形与水源条件影响着生产和往来。

明清时期，顺庆一带的乡村与县级行政、集市和宗教场所相联系。十七世纪的战争严重冲击四川多地的人口和生产，随后重新聚居和恢复改变了乡村社会。营山处在这一更广阔的地区背景之中，地方家庭的耕作与交换连接着村落和周边市场。

english: Yǐngshàng lies in the flat country of northwestern Ānhuī where the Yǐng River runs into the often-flooding Huái. Just downstream, at Zhèngyáng, the Yǐng and the Pì meet the Huái at an old river crossing; the west bank, Western Zhèngyáng, belongs to Yǐngshàng and the east bank to Shòuxiàn. In the Míng and Qīng a customs barrier stood there as the Zhèngyáng Pass, taxing the boats that carried grain and goods between the central plain and the lower Huái.
simp_chinese: 颍上位于安徽西北部的平原上，颍河在此汇入常年易涝的淮河。下游的正阳是颍河、淠河汇入淮河处的古渡口，淮河西岸的西正阳属颍上，东岸的东正阳属寿县。明清两代这里设有钞关，称正阳关，对往来于中原与淮河下游的粮船货船征税。

english: The Yǐng River flows southeast across the plains of Hénán and Ānhuī to join the Huái. Along its course it passes settlements including Tàihé, Yǐngzhōu, and Yǐngshàng, gathering waters from other streams. Its broad valley forms part of the river network that links the inland plain with the Huái basin.
simp_chinese: 颍水自河南、安徽平原向东南流入淮河，沿途经过太和、颍州、颍上等地，并接纳其他河流的来水。宽阔的河谷属于连接内陆平原与淮河流域的水系。

english: Yǐngzhōu lies on the plain of the Yǐng River, west of the Huái. Its West Lake attracted scholars and officials, among them the Sòng writers Ōuyáng Xiū and Sū Shì. Both served at Yǐngzhōu and wrote about the lake’s scenery, leaving a literary tradition in which its waters were remembered alongside the more famous West Lake of Hángzhōu.
simp_chinese: 颍州坐落在淮河以西的颍河平原。城西湖水吸引了众多文人和官员，宋代的欧阳修、苏轼都曾在颍州任职，并写下吟咏西湖的诗文。这片湖水因而在文学中与更著名的杭州西湖并称。

english: Yining was a county in the mountainous country northwest of Guilin. During the Southern Song, an exchange market was established there to facilitate trade between the peoples of the mountains and Han districts. A Ming magistrate, Liang Shunfu, praised the evening view from a fortified hill east of the town in a poem of 1520: below lay the county seat, its river and fields. In 1571 Yining became subordinate to the newly established Yongning Prefecture.
simp_chinese: 义宁是桂林西北山区的一处县邑。南宋时，官府在这里设立博易场，便利山中各族与汉地交换物产。1520年，明代知县梁顺甫曾作诗赞美县城东面登高岭的晚景：山上有营寨，山下可望见城邑、江流与田野。1571年，义宁改隶新设的永宁州。

english: Yinjiang lies in the hills west of Fanjing Mountain, on a river whose old name gave the district its own. The Yuan established the Siyinjiang chieftaincy here; in 1495 the Ming removed its chief Zhang Heling and replaced the hereditary office with Yinjiang County. The mountain country also supported religious communities. Xiyan Temple, already established by the Song period, was among the Buddhist sites known in the region, where temples stood amid the forests and valleys surrounding Fanjing Mountain.
simp_chinese: 印江位于梵净山以西的丘陵，因境内河流的旧名而得名。元代在此设思印江长官司；1495年明朝革除土官张鹤龄，将长官司改为印江县。山地中也有宗教社群，西岩寺在宋代已有建置，是梵净山周围森林河谷中的佛教寺院之一。

english: Yinshaluo was a principality in the mountains west of the Lancang River. In 1329 the Yuan established an administration over Yinshaluo and neighboring Mulian, with its seat at Shangyun. In 1348 Si Kefa of Luchuan advanced south and incorporated both territories into his expanding realm. After the Ming campaigns against Luchuan, the former lands of Yinshaluo passed through the hands of Mengding and were later divided between the chiefs of Menglian and Gengma.
simp_chinese: 银沙罗是澜沧江以西山区的一处地方政权。1329年，元朝为银沙罗与邻近的木连设立宣慰司，治所在上允。1348年，麓川首领思可法南进，将两地并入不断扩张的势力范围。明朝征讨麓川后，银沙罗故地先属孟定，后来划归孟连与耿马土司。

english: The Yin Mountains rise along the northern edge of the Hetao and the plains around Fengzhou. Their valleys and passes connect the cultivated lands south of the range with the open grasslands to the north. One such route, the White Road, climbed through the mountains towards Wuchuan; successive states guarded it with forts and relay stations, while pastoral communities used the uplands beyond.
simp_chinese: 阴山耸立在河套和丰州平原北缘，山谷与关口连接南方耕地及北方草原。白道便是其中一条道路，翻山通往武川。历代王朝在道旁设置要塞和驿站，山外高地则是牧人活动的地区。

english: Yinwum country lies in the northern Cape York Peninsula of Queensland. The Yinwum, also written Jinwum, are an Aboriginal people whose neighbours include the Mbewum and Wikampama to the southwest. Their country belongs to the tropical landscape of rivers and woodland between the peninsula's coasts.
simp_chinese: 因乌姆人的土地位于昆士兰约克角半岛北部。因乌姆亦写作金乌姆，是一个原住民族群，其西南邻族包括姆贝乌姆人和维坎帕马人。他们的土地属于半岛两岸之间由河流与林地组成的热带景观。

english:
Yin County is one of the few counties in China created under the Qin and kept into modern times. It took its name from Mount Chijin, and the Guoyu already has Goujian's lands of Yue reaching “east to Yin”. For centuries it was the county that held the prefectural seat of Mingzhou, called Qingyuan under the Southern Song and the Yuan and Ningbo under the Ming, where the Yong River meets the Fenghua and Yuyao rivers on the plain between Hangzhou Bay and the sea. From the Tang onward this was the port where ships from Japan put in, and Arab merchants kept their own quarter in the town.

In the hills east of the city, Tiantong Temple became one of the Five Mountains of Chan. Its abbot Zhengjue taught there for some thirty years after 1129, with over a thousand monks in residence. Dōgen studied under the master Rujing here in the 1220s and carried the Caodong teaching home to found the Sōtō school. In 1523 a brawl between rival Japanese tribute envoys at Ningbo turned into a riot and ended the open trade, and the Portuguese who traded at nearby Shuangyu as “Liampó” were driven out in 1548. Fan Qin began the Tianyi Pavilion in 1561 to house the books he had gathered in office. Its rare volumes went to the Siku Quanshu compilation in the eighteenth century.
simp_chinese:
鄞县是中国少数秦代设置、沿用至近代的县之一。县名相传得自赤堇山，《国语》已有勾践之地“东至于鄞”的说法。许多个世纪里，它是明州治所所在之县，南宋和元代称庆元，明代称宁波，位于奉化江、余姚江汇入甬江之处，处在杭州湾与大海之间的平原上。唐代以来，日本来船在此靠岸，阿拉伯商人也在城中自成聚居区。

城东山中的天童寺成为禅宗五山之一。正觉自1129年起在此说法约三十年，寺中僧众逾千。道元于1220年代在此师从如净，把曹洞宗法门带回日本，创立日本曹洞宗。1523年，日本两路朝贡使团在宁波发生争斗，演变成骚乱，公开的贸易就此中断；在邻近的双屿岛上经商、把此地称作利安波（Liampó）的葡萄牙人，于1548年被驱逐。范钦在1561年开始兴建天一阁，收藏他在各地任官时搜集的图书；十八世纪编纂《四库全书》时，阁中珍本被进献朝廷。

english: Yique, the “Gate of the Yi,” marks the place south of Luoyang where the Yi River passes between two hills like towers flanking a gateway. Better known as Longmen, the gorge became a great centre of Buddhist devotion. From the Northern Wei onward, worshippers cut caves and images into the cliffs, with extensive work continuing under the Tang. Later visitors still came to admire the river and the carved hills; a Ming account describes a prefect travelling south from Luoyang to the gateway.
simp_chinese: 洛阳以南，伊水穿过两山之间，山势如门阙，故称伊阙，又名龙门。自北魏起，信众在崖壁间开凿石窟与佛像，唐代继续大规模营造，使这里成为佛教胜地。后世游人仍来观赏河水与石刻；一篇明代游记记下了知府从洛阳南行，渡洛水后到达伊阙的行程。

english: Yir-Yoront country lies on the western side of Cape York Peninsula, near the rivers flowing into the Gulf of Carpentaria. In 1623 a Dutch expedition under Jan Carstenszoon landed on this coast and attempted to obtain supplies from its Aboriginal inhabitants. The encounter entered a much longer history of Yir-Yoront life and exchange in the region.
simp_chinese: 伊尔约朗特人的土地位于约克角半岛西部，靠近流入卡奔塔利亚湾的河流。1623年扬·卡斯滕松率领的荷兰探险队在这段海岸登陆，试图从原住民居民处取得补给。这次相遇只是伊尔约朗特人在当地漫长生活与交换历史中的一段。

english: Yirandali country lies in the inland plains of northwestern Queensland, where seasonal creeks cross open grass and woodland. The Yirandali are among the Aboriginal peoples of the region between the Flinders and Burdekin river systems. Their language and country are distinct from those of neighboring peoples.
simp_chinese: 伊兰达利人的土地位于昆士兰西北部的内陆平原，季节性溪流穿过开阔草地与林地。伊兰达利人是弗林德斯河与伯德金河水系之间地区的原住民族之一，其语言和土地与邻近各族各有区别。

english: The coast near Yirrkala faces the waters of northeastern Arnhem Land and the Gulf of Carpentaria. It is Yolŋu country, where coastal communities maintained trade with Makassan visitors. Their sailing vessels came seasonally for trepang, bringing goods and forging relationships that linked Arnhem Land to Sulawesi.
simp_chinese: 伊尔卡拉附近海岸面向阿纳姆地东北部和卡奔塔利亚湾的水域。这是雍古人的土地，沿海社群与望加锡访客保持贸易。访客的帆船季节性前来采集海参，带来货物并建立联系，将阿纳姆地与苏拉威西连接起来。

english: Yishan stands on the Long River amid the hills of northwestern Guangxi. As the seat of Qingyuan prefecture, it was a political and military centre for a region whose communities included many non-Han peoples. The prefecture had been created under the Southern Song and restored by the Ming after a period of Yuan reorganisation. In the early fifteenth century, resistance in Yishan and neighbouring districts brought repeated campaigns by Ming forces.
simp_chinese: 宜山坐落在广西西北丘陵之间的龙江畔，是庆远府治，也是当地的政治和军事中心。府境内居住着众多非汉族群。庆远府设于南宋，元代改制后，明朝恢复府名。十五世纪初，宜山及邻近地区发生反抗，明军多次出兵镇压。

english: Yishui stands beside the Yi River, with hills rising east of the county town. The ancient settlement was known as Dongguan under the Han and received the name Yishui in 596. Its inner and outer walls were repaired repeatedly from the Yuan onward. In 1511 an uprising reached the county and destroyed its offices and town buildings. Later inhabitants rebuilt and recorded their history in local gazetteers; a surviving edition was compiled by the magistrate Huang Ludeng in 1672.
simp_chinese: 沂水城临沂河，东面山岭起伏。汉代这里称东莞，596年改名沂水。县城有内外两道城墙，自元代起多次修缮。1511年，起事军队进入沂水，县署和城中建筑遭到破坏。地方后来重建城镇，并将往事写入县志；现存的一部县志由知县黄胪登于1672年主持编修。

english: The Yita Lhavos are a Nivaclé group whose name refers to the people of the scrubland. They belong to the Indigenous world of the Gran Chaco, a region of forests, open country and seasonal wetlands. Other Nivaclé groups are associated with the Pilcomayo River and the inland plains. Their Mataguayan language joins these communities, whose livelihood traditionally included hunting, fishing, gathering and small-scale cultivation.
simp_chinese: 伊塔拉沃斯是尼瓦克莱人的一个群体，其名称指灌丛地的居民。他们属于大查科的原住民世界，这片地区森林、开阔地和季节性湿地交错。其他尼瓦克莱群体则与皮尔科马约河及内陆平原有关。马塔瓜约语族的共同语言将这些社群联系起来；传统生计包括狩猎、捕鱼、采集和小规模耕作。

english: Yitha Yitha country lies among the inland rivers and plains of southwestern New South Wales. The people were neighbours of Madi Madi and Nari Nari communities, connected across country shaped by the Darling and Murrumbidgee river systems. Floodplains, woodland and seasonal waterways formed part of this shared river landscape.
simp_chinese: 伊塔伊塔地区位于新南威尔士西南部的内陆河流和平原之间。当地人与马迪马迪、纳里纳里社群相邻，在达令河和马兰比吉河水系塑造的土地上彼此相连。泛滥平原、林地和季节性水道构成共同河流景观的一部分。

english: Yiwu lies in the hills and valleys of central Zhejiang. In 1559, amid the coastal raids that troubled the Ming empire, the general Qi Jiguang came here to recruit soldiers. He trained men from Yiwu and neighbouring districts into a disciplined force that fought raiders in Zhejiang and Fujian. The army later served on the northern frontier, carrying its experience from the southeastern coast to the Great Wall.
simp_chinese: 义乌位于浙江中部的丘陵与河谷之间。1559年，明朝东南沿海饱受倭寇袭扰，将领戚继光来到义乌招募士兵，将义乌及邻近地区的壮丁训练成军，在浙江、福建抗击倭寇。这支军队后来北调戍边，将东南沿海的作战经验带到了长城沿线。

english:
Yi County lies among the mountains of Huizhou, where villages of white walls and dark tiled roofs stand beside streams and fields. At Hongcun, the Wang lineage built a remarkable network of channels and ponds; at Xidi, houses and ancestral halls preserve the character of the region's merchant villages.

In the Yongle reign of the early Ming, Hongcun's residents diverted water through winding channels into a crescent-shaped pond at the village centre. The water served households and helped guard against fire. As the village grew, its people dug a larger South Lake in 1607. Together, the channels and ponds gave the settlement a distinctive plan, linking everyday life to a carefully arranged landscape of water.
simp_chinese:
黟县坐落于徽州群山之间，白墙黛瓦的村落依溪临田。宏村汪氏建造了精巧的水圳与池塘，西递的民居和宗祠则呈现徽州商人村落的风貌。

明永乐年间，宏村居民引水入村，经曲折水圳汇入村中心半月形的月沼，供人取用并帮助防火。随着人口增加，村民又于1607年在南边开凿南湖。水圳与池塘共同构成村落独特的格局，使日常生活与精心经营的水景相连。

sources.title: 2013 Annual Report of the Sustainable Tourism Observatory of Xidi-Hongcun Hongcun (Chinese-English) (Data 2012 and H1 2013).pdf

english:
Yìxiàn lies in the valleys at the foot of the Taihang Mountains, on the Yi River from which the town took its name. The Yuan governed Yizhou under Baoding Circuit, and in the Ming the county was merged into the department, which belonged to Baoding Prefecture. The Zijing Pass, one of the three inner passes of the Great Wall, stood in the mountains of the upper Juma River, in the district, and in 1449 the Oirat army of Esen came through it on its way to Beijing.

The Qing made the town an imperial necropolis. The Yongzheng emperor rejected an earlier site and chose Taiping Valley near Yizhou for his tomb. Work on the Tailing began in 1730, and the Western Qing Tombs grew up beneath the wooded slopes, with stone gateways, bridges and halls laid out along a ceremonial approach. In 1733 Yizhou was raised to a directly administered department, with Laishui County from Baoding and Guangchang County from Shanxi transferred to it, to manage the burial ground.
simp_chinese:
易县位于太行山东麓的山谷，因易水得名。元代易州隶保定路，明代易县省入州，州属保定府。拒马河上游的山地中有紫荆关，是长城内三关之一；1449年，也先率领的瓦剌军队由此入关，兵临北京。

清朝将这里选作皇家陵区。雍正皇帝放弃原先选定的陵址，改选易州太平峪为陵地，泰陵于1730年动工，清西陵由此在林木覆盖的山麓间建成，石牌坊、桥梁和殿宇沿神道依次排开。1733年，为管理陵区，易州升为直隶州，原属保定府的涞水县和山西的广昌县划归易州。

english:
Yixing, west of Lake Tai, became known for tea and pottery. Under the Ming, a government tea station checked certificates and taxed tea from the district and its neighbours. Changing habits of tea preparation in the sixteenth century encouraged local potters to make teapots from distinctive clay.

Unglazed Yixing wares became prized in the late Ming, with makers such as Shi Dabin celebrated for their work. The products travelled far beyond the county: in the seventeenth century Dutch and English trading companies carried them to Europe, where they inspired imitations.
simp_chinese:
太湖以西的宜兴以茶与陶器闻名。明代官府在此设茶叶验税机构，查验凭证并对本地及邻近地区的茶叶征税。十六世纪饮茶方式的变化，促使当地陶工用特色泥料制作茶壶。

宜兴无釉陶器在明末受到珍视，时大彬等制作者因其作品而闻名。产品远销县境之外：十七世纪荷兰和英国商贸公司将其运往欧洲，并引发当地仿制。

english: Yixing lay in the mountain country north of the Great Wall, on the approaches between Gubeikou and the grasslands. Under the Jin, the former town of Baitan was raised to Yixing County in 1203, within the territory of Xingzhou. The county continued under the Yuan, when the region belonged to the circuit of Shangdu. Its old town guarded a valley route through the northern hills.
simp_chinese: 宜兴位于长城以北山地，处在古北口通往草原的道路附近。金朝于1203年将白檀镇升为宜兴县，属兴州。元代宜兴仍为县，所在地区归上都路管辖。旧城坐落在北方山岭间的谷道上。

english: Yiyang lies on the Luo River west of Luoyang. Further upstream at Hancheng are the remains of an ancient city associated with the state of Han. The county was called Shou'an under the Tang, but the Yuan restored the name Yiyang and absorbed neighbouring Fuchang. Early in the Ming, officials and local residents undertook to rebuild the county's damaged Confucian school, contributing money and grain to restore its gates and hall after years of warfare.
simp_chinese: 宜阳位于洛阳以西的洛河畔，上游韩城一带留有战国韩国的古城遗迹。唐代此地称寿安，元代恢复宜阳之名，并将邻近的福昌并入。明初，地方官与士民捐俸出粟，修复战乱中受损的县学，重建庙门和大成殿。

english:
Yiyang stands beside the Zi River, where the waters of western Hunan flow toward Lake Dongting. Its name has endured through many changes in the territory administered from the town. In the Song, part of its mountain hinterland was separated to form the counties of Xinhua and Anhua.

Under the Ming and Qing, Yiyang belonged to Changsha Prefecture. The Zi carried the dark tea of Anhua downstream to Yiyang, tying the town to the tea markets of the interior. Farther upriver, specialist tea towns and merchants developed along both banks, with the river providing the means to carry their goods out of the mountains.
simp_chinese:
益阳坐落在资江边，江水从湘西山地流向洞庭湖。尽管县域历经变迁，益阳之名长期沿用。宋代曾从其山地腹地划出部分区域，设立新化、安化二县。

明清时期，益阳属长沙府。安化黑茶沿资江顺流而下，到达益阳，再进入内陆各地的茶叶市场。上游两岸兴起专营茶叶的市镇与茶行，资江舟船则把山中的茶运往外地。

english:
Yiyang lies on the Xin River in northeastern Jiangxi. Its name became known far beyond the county through a vigorous style of theatre that grew from southern drama and local speech. Yiyang singing was marked by high, forceful melodies and a performance in which one voice could be answered by others.

By the early Ming the style had spread across Jiangxi and into other provinces. As travelling companies adapted it to local languages and music, related forms appeared in Anhui, Zhejiang and elsewhere. These styles came to be known collectively as high-pitched singing, or gaoqiang. Their stories included the Buddhist tale of Mulian rescuing his mother, performed over many scenes for audiences at temples and festivals.
simp_chinese:
弋阳位于赣东北信江沿岸。南戏与当地语言相结合，形成富有力量的弋阳腔，使县名远播四方。其曲调高亢，演唱时常有一人开腔、众人帮唱的形式。

明初，弋阳腔已传遍江西并流向外省。戏班将其与各地语言、音乐结合，在安徽、浙江等地衍生出不同声腔，后来统称高腔。剧目中有佛教的目连救母故事，演员在庙会和节庆中连演多场，供观众欣赏。

english: Yiyang is a historic name in the hill country south of Luoyang, associated with the Yi River and the lands of Songzhou. The earlier Yiyang County was raised to a prefecture during the Song–Jin wars, and under the Jin the prefecture became known as Songzhou. In 1476 the Ming established a new Yiyang County from parts of Song County and neighbouring districts. Its gazetteer links the creation of the county to the settlement and registration of displaced households in the surrounding region.
simp_chinese: 伊阳是洛阳以南山地的古地名，与伊河及嵩州一带的历史相连。宋金战争期间，早先的伊阳县升为州，金代改称嵩州。1476年，明朝从嵩县及邻近地区划地，新设伊阳县。县志将这次建县与安置、登记周边地区的流民联系在一起。

english: Yiyuan is the hill country around the sources of the Yi River in central Shandong. One branch descends from the slopes southwest of Mount Lu, while another rises near Laosong Mountain; the waters meet before flowing southeast toward Yishui. Under the Yuan, Ming and Qing, the surrounding lands were divided among Yishui, Mengyin and Linqu. Villages and fields occupied the lower valleys, with wooded ridges and mountain streams between them.
simp_chinese: 沂源是山东中部沂河发源的山地。一支源流出自鲁山西南山坡，另一支发源于老松山附近，汇合后向东南流往沂水。元、明、清时期，这片地区分属沂水、蒙阴和临朐。村落与田地坐落在较低的谷地中，山岭、林木和溪流横亘其间。

english: Yízhāng sits on the southern slope of Qítián Ridge in the middle Nánlǐng Mountains, on the Húnán side of the border with Guǎngdōng. It began in 617, in the last years of the Suí, as Yìzhāng County, carved from Chēnxiàn; in 976 the character was changed to Yízhāng to avoid the name of Emperor Tàizōng of the Sòng, Zhào Guāngyì, and the county kept that name through the Yuán, Míng and Qīng, part of the mountain country of Chēnzhōu.
simp_chinese: 宜章位于南岭山脉中段骑田岭南麓，在湖南与广东交界的湖南一侧。隋大业十三年（617年）自郴县析置义章县，北宋太平兴国元年（976年）为避宋太宗赵光义讳改名宜章，此后元、明、清一直沿用，属群山环绕的郴州一带。

english: Yizhou lies in western Liaoning near the Daling River. Its ancient town, known as Yizhou under the Liao, preserves the great Buddhist temple of Fengguosi. Founded in 1020, the temple's vast main hall contains a group of painted clay Buddhas. Inscriptions record repairs under the Jin, Yuan, Ming and Qing, showing how successive generations maintained this remarkable monument of Liao architecture.
simp_chinese: 义州位于辽西大凌河附近，辽代称宜州。古城内的奉国寺是一座规模宏大的佛教寺院，创建于1020年，大雄殿中供奉着彩塑佛像。金、元、明、清各代的重修碑记显示，历代居民持续维护着这座珍贵的辽代建筑。

english: Yizhou was an old fortified centre west of the Liao River, associated with a Liao imperial princess and the households under her authority. Its site at Tayingzi preserves a Liao pagoda, a reminder of the Buddhist patronage of the families who held power here. A road ran east from Yizhou toward Kaiyuan, passing through other old towns. It remained an important route in Yuan and Ming times, with stations serving travelers along the way.
simp_chinese: 懿州是辽河以西的古老城镇，辽代曾属于一位皇族公主及其属户。塔营子城址留有辽塔，见证了当地权贵家族对佛教的信奉。一条道路从懿州向东通往开原，沿途经过其他旧城。元明时期，这条路仍是重要的东西交通线，沿途驿站为来往行旅提供服务。

english: Yizhou lies in southern Shandong, amid hills and orchards famous for their pomegranates. Local tradition credits the Han minister Kuang Heng with bringing the fruit home from imperial gardens; by the Ming, growers had established extensive orchards. The fruit was traded over long distances, and a sweet, soft-seeded variety was later sent to the Qing court as tribute. In 1369 the Ming reduced Yizhou to Yi County, which came under Yanzhou prefecture in 1385.
simp_chinese: 峄州位于山东南部，山坡上的石榴园颇为著名。传说汉代丞相匡衡从皇家园林将石榴带回故乡，至明代已形成大片榴园。果实远销各地，甜美的软籽石榴后来还作为贡品送往清廷。1369年明朝将峄州降为峄县，1385年改属兖州府。

english: Yjxa is the name by which the Karitiana call themselves, meaning “we” or “people” in their own language. They are an Indigenous people of the southwestern Amazon, traditionally associated with the valleys of the Candeias, Jamari and Jaci-Paraná, tributaries of the Madeira. Their language belongs to the Arikém family of the Tupian stock, within a region of considerable linguistic diversity.
simp_chinese: 伊日沙是卡里蒂亚纳人的自称，在他们的语言中意为“我们”或“人”。这一亚马孙西南部的原住民族传统上生活在坎代亚斯河、雅马里河和雅西－巴拉那河谷地，这些河流都是马德拉河的支流。他们的语言属于图皮语族的阿里肯语系，而这一地区有着丰富的语言多样性。

english: Yli-Kitka is the upper part of the broad Kitka lake system in northeastern Finland. Its waters and islands lie among wooded shores and fells west of Kuusamo. The Sámi community of Kitka drew much of its livelihood from fishing, moving among the lakes and their seasonal resources. The clear waters and long winters shaped the rhythm of life in this northern lake country.
simp_chinese: 于利基特卡是芬兰东北部广阔的基特卡湖系上部，湖水和岛屿位于库萨莫以西的林岸与山地之间。基特卡的萨米社区很大程度上以捕鱼为生，在湖泊之间移动，利用季节性资源。清澈湖水与漫长冬季塑造了这片北方湖区的生活节奏。

english: Ynakh lies in the broad country west of the Kolyma, near the Sededema. The latter travels 567 kilometres from the Alazeya Plateau to meet the Kolyma, whose waters continue north to the East Siberian Sea.
simp_chinese: 伊纳赫位于科雷马河以西、谢杰杰马河附近的广阔地区。谢杰杰马河从阿拉泽亚高原出发，流经五百六十余公里后汇入科雷马河，后者继续向北注入东西伯利亚海。

english: Ynakhsyt lies north of the Vilyuy and east of Lake Dyongkyudey, on the eastern part of the upper Vilyuy plateau. Forest, lakes and low valleys mark this inland country of western Yakutia. The Vilyuy flows eastward to join the Lena, and its tributaries carry the plateau's waters into the wider Arctic drainage. Winter ice covers the lakes and streams for months before the short summer thaw.
simp_chinese: 伊纳赫西特位于维柳伊河以北、焦恩丘杰伊湖以东，地处上维柳伊高原东部。森林、湖泊与低谷构成雅库特西部内陆的景观。维柳伊河向东汇入勒拿河，支流将高原水流送入更广阔的北极水系。湖泊与溪流冬季冰封数月，随后迎来短暂夏季融冻。

english: Yo stands beside the Komadugu Yobe, the river that flows east toward Lake Chad. In descriptions of Bornu, the river formed part of the boundary of the kingdom's heartland and was sometimes named after the town. Farther upstream its waters gather from rivers that descend through the Hausa country, before crossing the dry plains toward the lake. Along this course, Bornu's settlements faced the neighbouring lands to the north and west.
simp_chinese: 约奥位于科马杜古约贝河畔，河水向东流往乍得湖。在对博尔努的地理描述中，这条河构成王国腹地边缘的一部分，有时也以约奥镇命名。更上游的河流从豪萨地区汇集而来，随后穿过干燥平原，流向湖泊。沿着这条河道，博尔努的聚落与北方和西方的邻地相望。

english: Yo Loy recalls a Patwin village on the Sacramento River, whose name has also been recorded as Yoloi or Yodoi. The Patwin inhabited the country west of the river, from the Coast Range foothills south to the bays. River villages stood beside the Sacramento, where fishers caught salmon and sturgeon in weirs of wood and willow. Families gathered seeds from their own tracts, while women and children collected acorns from oak groves held by their communities.
simp_chinese: 约洛伊的名称留存了一座萨克拉门托河畔帕特温村庄的记忆，村名也记作约洛伊或约多伊。帕特温人居住在大河以西的地区，其土地从海岸山麓向南延伸到诸海湾。河畔村庄的居民在萨克拉门托河中以木桩和柳枝筑成鱼堰，捕捉鲑鱼和鲟鱼。各家在自己的地块采集种子，妇女和儿童则到社群所有的橡树林中收集橡实。

english: Yoberrore lies near Lake Towerrinning, a shallow wetland in the Arthur River system of southwestern Australia. Noongar people have long known the lake and its surrounding swamps as part of their country. Reeds fringe the water, which Thomas Bannister described as a rushy lagoon when he passed in 1832. The wetland lies near the Arthur and Beaufort rivers, whose waters belong to the wider Blackwood basin.
simp_chinese: 约贝罗雷靠近陶厄里宁湖，湖泊是澳大利亚西南部阿瑟河水系的一片浅湿地。努恩加人长期将湖泊及周围沼泽视为自身土地的一部分。水边生长着芦苇；1832年托马斯·班尼斯特经过时，将其描述为芦苇丛生的潟湖。这片湿地靠近阿瑟河与博福特河，两河同属更广阔的布莱克伍德河流域。

english: Yodzocahi, later known as Yanhuitlán, was a Mixtec lordship in the highlands of Oaxaca. Its rulers governed a community whose history and land claims were preserved in painted manuscripts and colonial documents. The house of the local lord stood at the centre of this political landscape. After the Spanish conquest, Indigenous nobles and communities continued to use their own traditions of record and authority within the new colonial order.
simp_chinese: 约佐卡希后来称为扬惠特兰，是瓦哈卡高地的米斯特克领地。统治者治理的社群以图绘手抄本和殖民文书保存历史与土地权利，地方领主的宅邸位于这一政治空间的中心。西班牙征服之后，原住民贵族与社群继续在新的殖民秩序中使用自己的记录和权威传统。

english: Yog Point lies on Catanduanes, the island east of the Bicol Peninsula facing the Philippine Sea. Its headland stands along a coast exposed to the Pacific, with the mountainous island rising behind it. Catanduanes forms the northern side of the approach to Lagonoy Gulf, across the water from the peninsulas and smaller islands of Luzon.
simp_chinese: 尤格角位于比科尔半岛以东的卡坦端内斯岛，面向菲律宾海。岬角所在海岸朝向太平洋，后方是多山的岛屿。卡坦端内斯构成拉戈诺伊湾入口的北侧，隔海与吕宋的半岛及小岛相望。

english: Yohualtepec was a tributary centre in the Mixteca Baja, a region of rugged valleys where the lands of Oaxaca, Puebla and Guerrero meet. The Codex Mendoza names it among the towns that sent tribute to the Triple Alliance. Their payments included turquoise objects and bundles of turquoise stones, materials obtained through far-reaching networks of exchange. Such records reveal the ties between Mixtec communities and the rulers of central Mexico before the Spanish conquest.
simp_chinese: 约瓦尔特佩克是下米斯特卡地区的贡赋中心，所在的崎岖谷地位于瓦哈卡、普埃布拉和格雷罗交界一带。《门多萨绘本》将它列为向三国同盟进贡的城镇之一。贡品包括绿松石制品和成包的绿松石，这些材料通过远距离交换网络获得。此类记录展现了西班牙征服前米斯特克社群与墨西哥中部统治者之间的联系。

english: Yoichi lies at the mouth of a river on the Sea of Japan, a district known for salmon and herring. The Matsumae domain assigned rights to trade with the local Ainu, and merchants later managed the trading places and fisheries. In 1773 a Matsumae retainer brought eighty-three fishermen from Kaminokuni, who built huts and fishing stations here. Ainu residents, the trading house and seasonal fishermen all took part in the herring and salmon fisheries.
simp_chinese: 余市位于流入日本海的河口，是出产鲑鱼与鲱鱼的地方。松前藩将与当地阿伊努人交易的权利分给家臣，后来商人接管了交易场所和渔场。1773年，一名松前藩士带领八十三名上之国渔民来到这里，搭建小屋和渔业番屋。阿伊努居民、场所经营者和季节性渔民都参与鲱鱼与鲑鱼捕捞。

english:
The Yojuane ranged across east central Texas, from the Colorado River northward toward the Red River. They were associated with the Tonkawa and other peoples of the region, whose communities moved between the rivers and prairies. By the second half of the eighteenth century the Yojuane were largely concentrated in the southern part of their former range.

In 1745 Yojuane representatives joined the Mayeye, Deadose and Ervipiame in asking the Franciscan Mariano Francisco de los Dolores to establish a mission in their country. They chose a site near the San Gabriel River, where San Francisco Xavier de Horcasitas was founded. Yojuane people lived at the mission between 1748 and 1756. After the missions were moved away, their descendants became part of the communities known as Tonkawa.
simp_chinese:
约胡安人在得克萨斯中东部广泛活动，范围从科罗拉多河向北延伸至红河。他们与通卡瓦及其他地区民族关系密切，这些社群在河流与草原之间迁徙。到十八世纪下半叶，约胡安人大多集中在原有活动范围的南部。

1745年，约胡安代表与马耶耶、德阿多塞和埃尔维皮亚梅人一同请求方济各会士马里亚诺·弗朗西斯科·德洛雷斯在他们的土地上建立传教站。他们选定圣加布里埃尔河附近的一处地点，圣弗朗西斯科哈维尔德奥尔卡西塔斯传教站便在此建立。1748至1756年间，约胡安人居住于此。传教站迁走后，他们的后代成为通卡瓦社群的一部分。

english: Yoko stands on the southern foothills of Adamawa, in a country inhabited by Vute communities. It became an outpost of the lamidate of Tibati, whose authority was established around 1830. A local chief bore the title of djaoro, and Fulbe horsemen maintained a garrison there. From Yoko, forces went south to collect tribute in ivory and captives from independent chiefdoms.
simp_chinese: 约科位于阿达马瓦南部山麓，处在武特人居住的地区。它后来成为蒂巴蒂拉米德国的前哨，后者的权力约于1830年建立。当地首领称为贾奥罗，富尔贝骑兵在此驻守。部队从约科南下，向独立酋邦征收象牙和奴隶作为贡赋。

english:
Yola lies on a sandstone ridge above the Benue River, in the upper Benue country where the land rises toward the Mandara Mountains to the north and the Shebshi Mountains to the south. Its name comes from the Fulfulde word for a great plain, a fitting description of the wide flat ground along the river. Before the Fulbe jihad, the hills and valleys here were held by smaller chiefdoms such as Bagale, whose people farmed the uplands, kept cattle, and traded through the river valley.

The Sokoto jihad of Usman dan Fodio spread into the upper Benue in the early nineteenth century. Its leader here was Modibbo Adama, a Fulani scholar who built a Muslim emirate across the Adamawa country and fought the chiefdoms around it.
simp_chinese:
约拉位于贝努埃河上方的一道砂岩高岗上，处于贝努埃上游地区，地势向北抬升至曼达拉山，向南连接什布希山。其名出自富拉尼语，意为“大平原”，正好描述河边那片宽阔平坦的土地。圣战之前，这一带的丘陵和河谷由巴加勒等小型酋邦占有，居民在高地耕作、饲养牛群，并沿河谷进行交换。

十九世纪初，乌斯曼·丹·福迪奥领导的索科托圣战向贝努埃上游扩展。当地的领导者是富拉尼学者莫迪博·阿达马，他在阿达马瓦地区建立穆斯林酋长国，并与周围的酋邦作战。

english:
The Yoli, known to the Spanish as Conchos, inhabited much of the Río Conchos basin in northern Mexico. Their communities lived along the river and its tributaries, from the mountain foothills toward the Rio Grande in the north. Colonial accounts named many distinct groups among them, reflecting a landscape of local communities rather than a single centralized state.

Spanish missions and mining settlements spread into Concho country during the seventeenth century. In 1653 people from Namiquipa sent a message to the Tarahumara offering an alliance against the Spaniards. Later uprisings brought Concho, Tarahumara and other communities together in resistance, while some mission villages also became places of negotiation and coexistence. The river remained a thread connecting the different peoples of this contested frontier.
simp_chinese:
约利人被西班牙人称为孔乔人，居住在墨西哥北部孔乔河流域的广大地区。他们的社群沿河流及支流分布，从山麓延伸至格兰德河方向。殖民记录列举了其中许多不同群体，呈现出由地方社群组成、而非单一中央国家统治的景象。

十七世纪，西班牙传教站和矿业聚落进入孔乔人的土地。1653年，纳米基帕的人向塔拉乌马拉人送信，提议结盟对抗西班牙人。后来的起义使孔乔、塔拉乌马拉和其他社群共同抵抗；一些传教村落则也成为谈判和共同生活的地方。河流始终连接着这片争夺中的边疆上不同的民族。

english: Yolŋu country encompasses the coastal and inland lands of northeastern Arnhem Land, including islands and waters of the Arafura Sea. Clans hold connections to estates, languages and ancestral traditions across this landscape. From at least the eighteenth century, Makassan crews came seasonally from Sulawesi to collect trepang and exchange goods with Yolŋu communities. Some Yolŋu travelled with the visitors across the sea, extending these relationships beyond the Australian coast.
simp_chinese: 雍古人的土地包括阿纳姆地东北部的海岸与内陆，也包括阿拉弗拉海的岛屿和水域。各氏族与这片土地上的领地、语言及祖先传统相联系。至少从18世纪起，望加锡船员季节性从苏拉威西驶来采集海参，与雍古社群交换货物。一些雍古人随访客出海，使这些联系延伸到澳大利亚海岸之外。

english:
Yolombó lies in the gold-bearing hills of northeastern Antioquia. An Indigenous settlement of that name was recorded in the sixteenth century, and San Lorenzo de Yolombó later became a colonial mining centre. Its streams and surrounding hills attracted people seeking gold, while the settlement grew into one of the important places of the province, drawing miners and merchants into its mountainous hinterland.

By the middle of the seventeenth century Yolombó had a substantial Spanish community, as recorded by its parish priest Mateo de Castrillón. Gold brought prosperity during the eighteenth century, but mining declined towards the end of that century as accessible deposits became exhausted. The town’s wealth and its mining society left a lasting place in the history of Antioquia.
simp_chinese:
约隆博位于安蒂奥基亚东北部的产金丘陵。十六世纪已有同名原住民聚落的记载，圣洛伦索德约隆博后来成为殖民采矿中心。溪流与周围山丘吸引淘金者，聚落也发展为该省重要地点之一，吸引矿工与商人进入山区腹地。

到十七世纪中叶，当地已有相当规模的西班牙人社群，堂区神父马特奥·德·卡斯特里洪留下了相关记述。黄金在十八世纪带来繁荣，但随着易于开采的矿床逐渐枯竭，世纪末矿业开始衰落。城镇的财富和采矿社会在安蒂奥基亚历史中留下了长久印记。

english:
Yonaguni lies at the southwestern end of the Ryukyu island chain, where open sea connects a small island with neighboring Yaeyama islands and the approaches toward Taiwan. Cultivated ground, grazing, fishing, and marine resources support local households. Cliffs, landing places, currents, and powerful storms shape the practical possibilities of travel, making island life dependent on both local production and careful maritime connection.

Island traditions remember a female leader, San'ai Isoba, around the turn of the sixteenth century. Yonaguni came under the Ryukyu kingdom in the early sixteenth century, though accounts differ on the precise date. After Satsuma's intervention in Ryukyu, a poll tax imposed from 1637 placed heavy demands on Sakishima islanders. Local traditions and maritime connections continued under these changing authorities.
simp_chinese:
与那国位于琉球岛链西南端，外海联系小岛、邻近八重山及台湾方向。耕地、放牧、捕鱼和海产支持家庭。绝壁、登陆点、洋流及强风暴塑造旅行可能，使生活既依地方生产，也靠谨慎海上联系。居民需要熟悉水陆资源，交通虽然困难，却使岛屿参与更广交换，地方环境经验十分重要。

岛上传统记得一位约在十五、十六世纪之交活动的女性首领桑爱伊索芭。与那国在十六世纪初纳入琉球王国，不同资料对具体年份说法不一。萨摩介入琉球之后，1637年起实施的人头税给先岛居民带来沉重负担；地方传统和海上联系仍在变化的权力关系中延续。

english: Between Yonaguni and Taiwan, a wide passage separates the westernmost Ryūkyū island from the larger land to its west. The warm Kuroshio flows north through these waters and enters the East China Sea through a deep break in the island chain. Its strong current is a defining feature of the crossing, linking the seas east of Taiwan with those along the Ryūkyūs.
simp_chinese: 与那国岛与台湾之间是一片宽阔水道，隔开琉球最西端的岛屿和西方较大的陆地。温暖的黑潮在此向北流动，经岛链中的深水缺口进入东海。这股强流是渡海时不可忽视的地理特征，也连接着台湾以东与琉球沿岸的海域。

english: Yǒng’ān grew around a settlement in the mountainous interior of Fújiàn. In 1452, following unrest in the region, the Míng established a county from lands formerly belonging to Shā County and Yóuxī. Its name means “lasting peace.” Nearby Gòngchuān was already an old settlement, its history reaching back to the Táng dynasty.
simp_chinese: 永安兴起于福建内陆山地的一处聚落。明景泰三年（1452年），朝廷在地方动乱之后从沙县、尤溪划地设县，以“永安”为名，寄望长久安定。附近的贡川则是更古老的聚落，其历史可追溯至唐代。

english: Yong'an was a market west of Liuyang, in the country watered by the Laodao River. It was once known as Laohu, a name judged unlucky because it sounded like the word for tiger. In 1694 the county magistrate ordered the market renamed Yong'an, meaning enduring peace. The old streets had gates at the upper and lower ends of the market, and shops served the communities of Liuyang's western countryside.
simp_chinese: 永安是浏阳西部的集市，捞刀河流经这一带。它旧称潦浒，因读音近似“老虎”，被认为不吉；1694年，知县下令改名永安，寄托长久安宁之意。旧街上市口、下市口各有栅门，商铺为浏阳西部乡村服务。

english: Yongchang lies on the Hexi Corridor between the Qilian Mountains and the desert ranges to the north. Rivers from the mountains support the cultivated plain around the town. Under the Yuan it was the seat of Yongchang Circuit, a district said to have taken its name from the palace of the Prince of Yongchang. The Ming replaced the circuit with a military garrison. In 1587 a bell and drum tower was built at the centre of the town, above arched passages opening in four directions.
simp_chinese: 永昌位于河西走廊，南有祁连山，北面是荒漠山岭。山中河水滋润城镇周围的耕作平原。元代这里为永昌路治所，相传路名取自永昌王宫所在。明朝废路设卫；1587年，城镇中心建起钟鼓楼，台基中辟有通向四方的拱门。

english: Yongchang stands below Mount Taibao on the road west from Dali. The city was a center of administration in western Yunnan from the time of Nanzhao, and its position linked the highlands with routes toward Tengchong and Burma. In the early Ming its earthen defenses were rebuilt in brick and stone. In 1395 the commander Hu Yuan enlarged the western walls to include Mount Taibao, joining the garrison on the hill to the main town.
simp_chinese: 永昌坐落在太保山下，位于大理向西的道路上。自南诏时期起，这里就是滇西的行政中心，连接高原与通往腾冲、缅甸的道路。明初，原有土城改以砖石修筑；1395年，指挥使胡渊扩建西城，将太保山纳入城墙，使山上驻军与主城连为一体。

english: Yongcheng lies on the eastern Henan plain, with the Mangdang Hills rising to its north and the Tuo River passing the town. In local tradition the hills sheltered Liu Bang before his rise to found the Han dynasty. Yongcheng was a county under Guide in Yuan times and remained part of the Guide administration under the Ming and Qing. Its Chongfa Temple pagoda, an octagonal brick tower of nine storeys, was built in the late eleventh century and stood above the old town through the centuries that followed.
simp_chinese: 永城位于河南东部平原，芒砀山耸立于北，沱河流经城旁。相传刘邦起兵之前曾藏身芒砀山，后来建立汉朝。元代永城为归德府属县，明清仍归归德管辖。城中的崇法寺塔建于十一世纪末，为八角九层砖塔，历经后世岁月，高出旧城之上。

english: Yongchuan lies in the hills of eastern Sichuan, west of Chongqing. Yongchuan County was established in 776 under the Tang dynasty and belonged to Changzhou. Its name is traditionally explained by three streams meeting south of the town in a shape resembling the character yong. The county's administrative status changed during the Mongol period before the name was restored. In the Qing dynasty, officials and local scholars compiled county gazetteers, preserving accounts of the district and its communities. The Yangtze flows along the southern part of the wider district; Songgai was a river port and a gathering place for merchants travelling between surrounding counties and Chongqing. Farms, market settlements and river transport connected the hilly countryside to the broader Sichuan basin.
simp_chinese: 永川位于重庆以西的川东丘陵。唐代大历十一年（776年）设永川县，属昌州。地方传说以城南三河汇流、形似篆文“永”字解释县名。元代县的建置曾有变化，后来恢复永川之名。清代，官员与地方士人编修县志，记载县境和地方事务。长江流经今永川地区南部，松溉是沿江码头和周边各县商贾往来重庆的物资集散地。农田、集镇与水路把丘陵乡村连接到更广阔的四川盆地。

english: Yǒngchūn lies inland from Quánzhōu in southern Fújiàn. Its earlier name, Táoyuán, recalled the streams that meet in the Táo valley. Raised to county status in 933, it was renamed Yǒngchūn five years later under the kingdom of Mǐn. The county remained connected to Quánzhōu through the Sòng period.
simp_chinese: 永春位于福建南部、泉州的内陆。旧名桃源，与众水汇聚的桃溪有关。五代后唐长兴四年（933年）升为桃源县，五年后闽国改名永春。宋代，永春仍属泉州。

english: Yongcong lies among the hills and river valleys of the Dong country in southeastern Guizhou. Its hereditary chieftaincy formed part of the network of local offices under Liping. In 1431, after the local chief Li Ying died without an heir, the Ming court ordered the native office converted into a county governed by an appointed magistrate. The transition took several years to complete, and Yongcong continued as a county through the Qing, linking the surrounding villages to the prefectural seat at Liping.
simp_chinese: 永从位于黔东南侗乡的山丘与河谷之间，其世袭长官司是黎平府下属的地方土司之一。1431年，土官李瑛无嗣，明廷下令将长官司改为县，派流官治理。这一变更经过数年才完成；永从县延续至清代，将周围村寨与黎平府治联系起来。

english: Yongdae Cape projects into the East Sea on the coast of Hamgyŏng, forming a prominent point near the entrance to the waters off Songjin. The coast north of the cape rises high above the sea and is fringed by rocks. Farther west lies the broad sweep of East Korea Bay, where the shoreline curves toward the lands around Hamhŭng and Yŏnghŭng.
simp_chinese: 龙台角从咸镜海岸伸入东海，是松津近海入口附近醒目的岬角。岬角以北的海岸高耸于海面，岸边分布岩礁。更西方是宽阔的东朝鲜湾，海岸向咸兴和永兴一带弯曲。

english: Yǒngdìng lies in the mountains of western Fújiàn, among the Hakka settlements of the old Tīngzhōu region. It became a county in 1478 under the Míng, bringing the number of counties in Tīngzhōu Prefecture to eight. The district formed part of a wider inland landscape in which Hakka communities lived across the borders of Fújiàn and Guǎngdōng.
simp_chinese: 永定位于福建西部山地，是旧汀州地区客家人的聚居之地。明成化十四年（1478年）设永定县后，汀州府共辖八县。这片内陆山地与闽粤边界另一侧的客家聚落相连。

english: Yongfeng lies east of Shangrao in the hills at the northern foot of the Wuyi Mountains. It began as a market town under Shangrao and became a county in 1074. The county belonged to Guangxin, its streams draining toward the Xin River. In 1391 the Ming registered more than sixteen thousand households here. In 1731 the Qing renamed it Guangfeng, distinguishing it from another Yongfeng County in Ji'an Prefecture to the west.
simp_chinese: 永丰位于上饶以东、武夷山北麓的丘陵地带。这里原是上饶所属集镇，1074年升为县，后属广信府，境内溪流汇向信江。明代1391年的户籍记载全县有一万六千余户。1731年，清朝为区别吉安府的同名永丰县，将此县改名广丰。

english: Yongfeng lies on the En River east of the Gan in central Jiangxi. On the riverbank west of the county town stood Bao'en Temple and its pagoda, a landmark associated with the local Ouyang family. The Ji'an prefectural gazetteer records that descendants built the tower beside the temple in 1369, at the beginning of the Ming. Its brick storeys rose above the river and the fields beyond, preserving a visible sign of the county's religious and family traditions.
simp_chinese: 永丰位于江西中部赣江以东，恩江流经县境。城西江畔有报恩寺及其古塔，与地方欧阳氏家族相关。《吉安府志》记载，明朝初年的1369年，后裔在寺旁建塔。砖塔层层耸立于江水和田野之上，成为地方宗族与佛教传统的地标。

english: Yongfeng was a market settlement in the middle district of Xiangxiang County in central Hunan. Its inhabitants became known for a pungent chilli sauce, prepared by fermenting wheat, mixing it with peppers and leaving the mixture to mature in the sun. Local accounts trace the craft to the late Ming. Tea was another important crop in the surrounding countryside during the Qing, when households often grew bushes in their own gardens. In 1691 Yongfeng was among the places given a local postal station.
simp_chinese: 永丰是湘中湘乡县中里的集镇，以辣酱闻名。制作时先发酵小麦，再加入辣椒，置于阳光下曝晒；地方记载称，明末这里已有人制作这种酱。清代周围乡村还广种茶树，许多农户在自家园中种茶。1691年，永丰等地设立铺司，成为地方传递站点之一。

english: Yongfu lies among wooded hills southwest of Guilin. Established in the Tang, the county passed through several changes of administration in later centuries. In 1440, under the Ming, neighboring Liding County was absorbed into Yongfu. The county belonged to Guilin Prefecture before it was placed under the newly established Yongning Prefecture in 1571. Rivers and valleys through this hilly country connect Yongfu with the lands around Guilin and the Liu River basin.
simp_chinese: 永福位于桂林西南的林木丘陵之间。县置于唐代，此后隶属屡有变化。1440年，明朝将邻近的理定县并入永福。永福原属桂林府，1571年改隶新设的永宁州。山间河谷将这里与桂林附近地区及柳江流域相连。

english: Yǒngfú lies inland from Fúzhōu, among the hills of Fújiàn. The county was established as Yǒngtài in 766 from parts of Hòuguān and Yóuxī. In 1102, under the Northern Sòng, it received the name Yǒngfú, which it retained through the Yuán, Míng, and Qīng periods.
simp_chinese: 永福位于福州内陆的福建山地。唐永泰二年（766年），朝廷从侯官和尤溪划地设永泰县。北宋崇宁元年（1102年）改名永福，元、明、清时期沿用这一名称。

english: Yonghe lies in the hills above the Yellow River, on the western edge of Shanxi. Its county town contains a Confucian temple whose main hall dates from the Ming dynasty. Temples in the surrounding villages honoured other powers, including a Dragon King shrine at Baijiatuyou and a river god temple at Duanjiawa. Together they reflect the varied religious life of a district shaped by mountains and the great river.
simp_chinese: 永和位于山西西缘、黄河之上的丘陵地带。县城里的文庙大成殿建于明代，周围村落还有供奉其他神灵的庙宇，包括白家土要的龙王庙和段家坬的河神庙。这些祠庙共同展现了山河之间多样的地方信仰。

english: Yŏngil Bay opens onto the East Sea on Korea's southeastern coast. The Hyŏngsan River flows north from the Kyŏngju country before turning east and entering the bay. Its inner shores are shallow, while the water deepens toward the mouth. The name Yŏngil recalls the morning sun rising over the eastern sea, a fitting image for the settlements looking across these waters.
simp_chinese: 迎日湾位于朝鲜东南海岸，向东海敞开。兄山江从庆州一带向北流，又转向东注入海湾。内湾沿岸水浅，越近湾口则越深。迎日之名令人想起东海上升起的朝阳，也呼应着面向这片水域的聚落。

english: Yongjia is the old county of Wenzhou, on the Ou River near its mouth. On Jiangxin Island, two pagodas rise above Buddhist temples in the river channel. Their height made them useful landmarks for ships approaching the port as well as places of worship. The towers were repaired during the Ming, including work on the west tower in 1378 and on both towers in the 1590s. Lamps were lit in them at night to guide vessels, joining the island's religious life with the navigation of Wenzhou's harbour.
simp_chinese: 永嘉是温州的旧县，位于瓯江入海口附近。江心屿上的两座佛塔高耸于寺院之上，既是礼佛之处，也是船只驶近港口时可见的标志。 明代曾多次修葺双塔，包括1378年的西塔工程以及1590年代对东西两塔的修缮。塔上夜间点灯，为航船指引方向，将江上岛屿的宗教生活与温州港航运联系在一起。

english: Yongkang lies in central Zhejiang, where generations of craftspeople have worked metal as well as wood, bamboo and stone. Local records mention copper mining as early as the Five Dynasties. In the Yuan period, copper and iron locks from Yongkang were presented as tribute. By the Qing, many farming households also practised a craft, selling their products or travelling from village to village to work for customers.
simp_chinese: 永康位于浙江中部，历代匠人加工金属，也从事木、竹、石等手艺。地方志记载，五代时这里已有铜矿开采；元代永康所制铜锁、铁锁曾作为贡品。清代许多农户兼习手艺，或出售制品，或走村串户为人加工。

english:
Yongming was a county of Daozhou in southern Hunan, with its seat on the south bank of the Xiao River. The district lay among the valleys and ridges near the boundary with Guangxi. Its name came from Yongming Ridge, also known as Dupangling, one of the mountain chains of the Nanling.

The county had been suppressed in 1072 and its territory joined to Yingdao, but was restored in 1086 under the Song. It remained a separate county through the Yuan, Ming and Qing, its seat looking across the Xiao toward the lands to the north.
simp_chinese:
永明是湘南道州所属的一座县，县治位于潇水南岸，周围是接近广西的山岭与河谷。县名得自永明岭，即南岭山系中的都庞岭。

宋代的1072年，永明县一度被省为镇，并入营道；1086年又恢复县制。此后历元、明、清三代，永明仍为独立的县，县城隔潇水与北岸相望。

english: Yongmingcheng was a coastal place named in accounts of the Yuan road network reaching the eastern sea. A route from Xixiangzhou on the Songnen plain passed through a succession of stations toward Yongmingcheng, linking the interior with peoples of the coast. The surrounding bays and wooded hills lie near the mouth of the Suifen River. Earlier the wider country belonged to Balhae's Suibin region, known for its horses and its connections across northeastern Asia.
simp_chinese: 永明城是元代通往东部海岸的驿路记载中的地点。道路从松嫩平原的西祥州出发，经过一系列站点抵达永明城，将内陆与沿海人群相连。周围海湾和林木山丘靠近绥芬河口；更早时，这片地区属于渤海国的率宾地方，以良马及通往东北亚各地的联系闻名。

english:
Yongnian belongs to the southern Hebei plain, where cultivated fields and market routes support a landscape of villages and administrative centers. Grain farming and household production supplied local communities, while exchange brought tools, cloth, salt, and other necessities. Water management and seasonal rainfall shaped harvests and the reliability of movement across the lowlands.

The old walled town of Yongnian, also known as Guangfu, served as an administrative seat over successive periods. Its earthen walls were encased in brick beginning in 1542, a project that took thirteen years. Low-lying wetlands surrounded the town, while the Hongji Bridge carried traffic across the Fuyang River to its east.
simp_chinese:
永年属于冀南平原，耕地和市场路线支持村庄及行政中心组成的景观。谷物农业与家庭生产供应社群，交换带来工具、布匹、盐和必需品。治水及季节降雨，影响收成和低地移动可靠程度。

永年古城又称广府城，历代曾为郡县治所。明嘉靖二十一年（1542年）开始将土城包砖，工程历时十三年。古城周围是低洼水淀，东侧的弘济桥则跨越滏阳河，方便往来。

english: Yongning lay in the mountains on the Sichuan-Guizhou frontier, ruled by the hereditary Yi She family. Its chiefs controlled a broad district of valleys and passes, serving the Ming court while maintaining their own forces. The borderland linked the upper Yangtze country with the mountains of Guizhou and Yunnan. In 1621 the chief She Chongming raised troops ostensibly to aid the Ming war in Liaodong. His forces instead seized Chongqing, and the rebellion spread through Sichuan and Guizhou. Joined by An Bangyan of Shuixi, She fought the imperial armies for years. The conflict brought great destruction to the region and ended in the removal of the Yongning chieftaincy.
simp_chinese: 永宁位于川黔交界的山区，由彝族奢氏世袭统治。土司控制着广大河谷和关隘，既为明朝效力，也拥有自己的军队。这片边地连接长江上游与贵州、云南的山区。1621年，土司奢崇明以赴辽作战为名募兵，部众却占据重庆，叛乱随之蔓延到四川和贵州。水西的安邦彦加入后，双方与明军长期交战。这场战争给地区带来严重破坏，永宁土司制度最终被废除。

english: Yongning lies in a high basin near Lugu Lake, enclosed by the mountains of the Yunnan-Sichuan border. The A family ruled here as hereditary chiefs, their authority continuing through the Yuan, Ming and Qing. In 1406 the Ming established Yongning as a prefecture and recognized the family's hereditary office. The basin was home to Mosuo communities whose family and marriage customs endured alongside the changing demands of imperial rule.
simp_chinese: 永宁位于泸沽湖附近的高原盆地，四周为滇川交界的群山环抱。阿氏在此世袭为土官，统治延续至元、明、清各代。1406年，明朝设置永宁府，承认阿氏的世袭职位。盆地也是摩梭社群的家园，其家庭与婚姻习俗在王朝治理的变化中延续。

english: Yōngníng lies in the Yōng River country around Nánníng, a long-established centre of southern Guangxi. The town was known as Yōngzhōu under the Tang and Song, with Xuānhuà as its county seat. The Yuan renamed the circuit Nánníng in 1324, and the Ming made it a prefecture. Merchants travelled the river routes east towards the Xī River, while the city governed a broad hinterland of counties and hereditary native jurisdictions towards the southern frontier.
simp_chinese: 邕宁位于广西南部南宁周围的邕江流域。唐宋时期此地称邕州，以宣化为附郭县；元泰定元年（1324年）改称南宁路，明代设南宁府。商人可沿江东行进入西江水系，府城则管理南方广大腹地的州县与世袭土司。

english: Yongning lies in the Luo River valley among the mountains of western Henan. A county seat here from the twelfth century, it remained under Henan Prefecture throughout the Yuan, Ming and Qing. The county's school and Confucian temple were repaired under the Ming and restored again in the Kangxi reign by the magistrate Tong Fuwei. His work also extended to the walls and government buildings; the county gazetteer credits him with encouraging merchants to rebuild on vacant urban plots.
simp_chinese: 永宁位于豫西群山之间的洛河谷地，十二世纪时已是县治。元、明、清三代，永宁均属河南府。县学和文庙在明代曾得到修葺，清康熙年间知县佟赋伟再次修复，又整治城墙和官署。县志还记载，他鼓励商人在城中荒废的地基上建屋，使市集重获生气。

english: Yongning lies in the mountainous border country of western Jiangxi. It was created in 1330 under the Yuan from Shengye township of Yongxin, because the journey to the older county seat was long and dangerous and its inhabitants found official duties burdensome. The new county belonged to Ji'an Circuit, and continued under Ji'an Prefecture in the Ming and Qing.
simp_chinese: 永宁位于江西西部的山地边境。元代1330年，朝廷从永新县划出胜业乡设置永宁县：当地通往原县治的道路遥远险阻，居民往返承担差役十分艰难。新县隶属吉安路，明清时期则属吉安府。

english: Yǒngpíng was the county seat of Jìngzhōu in the mountain country of southwestern Hunan. It stood at the centre of a region where Miao and Dong communities lived among the river valleys and wooded hills. The early Ming briefly raised Jìngzhōu to a prefecture in 1370. Six years later the government reduced it to a directly administered zhou and absorbed Yǒngpíng County into it, so that the town became the seat of the zhou itself.
simp_chinese: 永平是湘西南山地靖州的附郭县，周围河谷和林岭间居住着苗、侗等社群。明洪武三年（1370年），朝廷将靖州升为府；六年后又降为直隶州，并将永平县省入州中，城镇遂成为靖州直属治所。

english: Yongping lies on the old Bonan road between Dali and Yongchang. West of the town, the road descends to the Lancang River, where the Jihong Bridge carried travelers across a deep gorge. A bamboo suspension bridge was recorded here under the Tang, and later generations rebuilt the crossing. During the Chenghua reign of the Ming, the monk Liaoran raised funds for an iron-chain bridge, securing a vital passage on the road into western Yunnan.
simp_chinese: 永平位于大理与永昌之间的博南古道上。道路向西降至澜沧江边，霁虹桥跨越深谷，供旅人通行。唐代已有竹索桥的记载，此后历代不断重修。明成化年间，僧人了然募资改建铁索桥，使这条进入滇西的要道得以继续通行。

english: Yongqing lies on the plain south of Beijing, in a landscape crossed by rivers flowing toward the Bohai Sea. Its county belonged to the capital region under successive dynasties. In 1698 a new channel and embankments were built to guide the Yongding River past Gu'an and the northern edge of Yongqing, protecting the capital and nearby fields from a river known for changing course.
simp_chinese: 永清位于北京以南的平原，流向渤海的河流穿过这一地区。历代永清县都与京畿联系密切。1698年，官员开挖新河道并筑堤，引永定河经固安和永清北部流去，以保护京城及附近田地免受河流改道之害。

english: Yongshan lies on the southern side of the Jinsha River, where deep valleys cut the high mountains of northeastern Yunnan. Its country belonged to the wider Wumeng region before the Qing established Yongshan County in 1728, following the replacement of the hereditary chiefs with appointed officials. The river separated its mountainous settlements from the Mahu country to the north, while paths connected the valleys with the plateau inland.
simp_chinese: 永善位于金沙江南侧，深谷切入滇东北的高山。此地原属乌蒙地区，清廷改土归流后于1728年设永善县。大江将这里的山地聚落与北岸马湖地区分隔开来，山路则连接各处河谷和内陆高原。

english: Yongshou lies on the uplands north of the Wei River plain, between the valleys leading toward Binzhou and Qianzhou. Its name derives from the Yongshou plateau. The county seat moved several times in the Tang and Song, eventually returning to Mating. The Yuan placed the county under Qianzhou in 1268, and a town wall was built at Mating in 1344. Yongshou remained under Qianzhou during the Ming and Qing, with its historic seat still at Mating.
simp_chinese: 永寿位于渭河平原以北的高地，处在通往邠州与乾州的河谷之间，县名取自永寿原。唐宋时期县治数度迁移，最终回到麻亭。元朝于1268年将永寿划归乾州，1344年在麻亭修筑县城。明清两代永寿仍属乾州，县治也继续设在麻亭。

english: Yǒngshùn was a hereditary native chiefship in the hill country of northern Guangxi, under the wider jurisdiction of Qìngyuǎn. The Ming established the office in 1492, recognising a local line of chiefs in a region where many communities were governed through inherited titles. Its name was shared with a much larger chiefship in distant Hunan, but the two were separate. Yǒngshùn remained a native office through the Ming and Qing periods, preserving local authority within the imperial administrative system.
simp_chinese: 永顺是广西北部丘陵间的世袭土司，归庆远府管辖。明弘治五年（1492年）设永顺长官司，承认地方首领的世袭职权。其名与湖南较大的永顺土司相同，两者却是不同建置。广西永顺历经明清仍保有土官制度，在帝国行政体系中延续地方权力。

english: Yǒngshùn was the seat of a powerful hereditary chiefship in western Hunan, ruled for generations by the Péng family. Their authority grew from the old Xīzhōu region, whose chiefs negotiated boundaries with the rulers of Chu in the tenth century. The Ming recognised Yǒngshùn as a native pacification commission, ruling a network of subordinate offices across the mountain valleys. In the late Ming, chief Péng Yuánjǐn rebuilt the old chief's town with brick and timber buildings on terraced ground. The chiefship survived into the Qing, but in 1729 its ruler Péng Zhàohuái surrendered his authority and the government created Yǒngshùn Prefecture. The former hereditary domains were reorganised into counties administered by appointed officials.
simp_chinese: 永顺是湘西势力强大的世袭土司治所，彭氏世代统治这里。其权力源于旧溪州，十世纪溪州首领曾与楚国统治者议定疆界。明朝设永顺宣慰司，统辖山谷间众多下属土司。明末，土司彭元锦重修老司城，在层层台地上兴建砖木建筑。土司制度延续至清代；雍正七年（1729年），彭肇槐纳土归流，朝廷设永顺府，将原有世袭辖地改为流官治理的州县。

english: Yongxin lies on the He River in western Jiangxi. The river winds past the county town and joins other streams on its way east towards the Gan. Its rocky Longshan rapids made navigation difficult, with boats having to turn through narrow gaps between stones. In 1330, the distant and mountainous Shengye township was separated from Yongxin to form Yongning County.
simp_chinese: 永新位于江西西部的禾水沿岸。禾水绕过县城，向东汇合诸流，最后流入赣江。河上的砻山滩乱石险峻，舟行须在石缝间曲折穿过。元代1330年，远离县治的山地胜业乡从永新析出，另置永宁县。

english:
Yongxing lies on the Bian River in southern Hunan. Its old name was Bian County, established under the Han, while the name Yongxing was adopted in 1073 under the Song. The river winds between hills and red sandstone cliffs, and its waters join the Lei River on their way toward the Xiang.

The Bian also gave the county access to a wider trading world. Local records describe silk, cotton yarn, cloth and southern goods arriving by water from places including Changsha and Xiangtan. Boats navigating the river brought the products of distant markets into a county whose history had long been tied to its waterway.
simp_chinese:
永兴位于湘南便江沿岸。这里在汉代置便县，宋代于1073年改名永兴。便江穿行于丘陵和红砂岩峭壁之间，汇入耒水，最终通向湘江。

这条河也把县城与更远的市场联系起来。地方记载中，长沙、湘潭等地的绸缎、棉纱、棉布和南货经便江水路运入，舟船往来使远方物产进入这座与河流相伴的县城。

english: Yǒngxīng lies near the Fù River in the country south of the Yangtze. The district bore several names through successive dynasties, including Xiàzhì, Yángxīn, and Yǒngxīng. From the Sòng through the Qīng, its administrative centre was known as Xīngguó, a seat governing the river valleys and settlements of eastern Húběi.
simp_chinese: 永兴位于长江以南的富河附近。历代这里曾称下雉、阳新、永兴等名。宋至清时期，地方行政中心称兴国，管辖湖北东部的河谷与聚落。

english: Yonibana lies in the Yoni country of central Sierra Leone, east of the coastal peninsula. The Yoni are part of the Temne-speaking world, whose communities cultivated rice and other crops in a landscape of forest, savanna and river valleys. The history of Yoni is preserved in accounts of its chiefs and their relationships with neighbouring Temne communities. Its inland position places it between the coast and the upper river country, in a region long shaped by the movement of people and exchange.
simp_chinese: 约尼巴纳位于塞拉利昂中部的约尼地区，在海岸半岛以东。约尼人属于泰姆内语世界，当地社群在森林、草原和河谷间种植稻米等作物。约尼的历史保存在关于各代首领及其与邻近泰姆内社群关系的记述中。这片内陆地区处于海岸与河流上游之间，长期受到人口往来和交换的影响。

english: The Yoniveem rises in the highlands of the Chukchi Peninsula and flows north to Kolyuchin Bay on the Chukchi Sea. Its valley lies in a tundra landscape of lakes and low mountains; Lake Ioni stands near its middle course and is linked to the river by a channel. Snow and ice cover the basin through the long winter before the brief summer melt feeds its waters.
simp_chinese: 约尼维姆河发源于楚科奇半岛高地，向北流入楚科奇海的科柳钦湾。河谷位于湖泊和低山交错的苔原中，伊奥尼湖坐落在河流中游附近，并由一条水道与之相连。漫长冬季冰雪覆盖流域，短暂夏季的融水则补给河流。

english:
Yoov We Teuh, rendered in English as Uinta, comes from a Ute term for pine forest. It names the high range and eastern valleys between the Bear and Green river systems. Pine, fir, willow and upland meadows supplied fuel, shelter and game, while passes linked the Great Basin with the river country to the east.

Ute families used these valleys seasonally for hunting, fishing, gathering and travel. In 1776 the Dominguez-Escalante expedition crossed into the Uinta Basin while seeking a route from Santa Fe to California; its members depended on Ute guides and local knowledge. The journey produced a written account, but no lasting settlement or direct government replaced existing Ute authority.

Fur trading changed the pace of outside contact. William Ashley crossed the Uinta Mountains in 1825 to reach the Green River rendezvous, and American and Mexican trappers followed its streams during the next decade. Mounted Uinta Ute bands traded, supplied and sometimes resisted these intruders. Antoine Robidoux established a trading post in the basin in the 1830s. By 1837 the region was entering wider commercial networks, yet its routes and seasonal economy remained grounded in Ute life.
simp_chinese:
尤夫韦特乌在英语中写作尤因塔，源于犹特语对松树或松林的称呼。这一地点由此得名于高耸的东西向山系及东坡谷地，山间溪流分别流向贝尔河与格林河水系。扭叶松、冷杉、柳树和开阔高地草甸提供燃料、居所材料和猎物，山口则把大盆地同东面的河谷与高原连接起来。

犹特家庭按季节利用这些谷地狩猎、捕鱼、采集和旅行。他们的道路依水源和避风处而行，并非固定驿道。1776年，多明格斯—埃斯卡兰特远征队在寻找新墨西哥至加利福尼亚路线时进入尤因塔盆地，依靠犹特向导及当地知识穿越。这次西班牙行程留下了文字记录，却没有建立长期聚落，也未以直接统治取代犹特人的权威。

毛皮贸易改变了外部联系的速度。1825年，威廉·阿什利越过尤因塔山脉前往格林河集散会，美国与墨西哥捕兽者随后沿溪流进入。骑马的尤因塔犹特各族参与交易、提供补给，有时也抵抗入侵者。1830年代，安托万·罗比杜在盆地设立商站。到1837年，这一地区已进入更广商业网络，其聚落、道路和季节经济仍扎根于犹特人的生活。

english: The Yoowetum, or Uinta-ats, were a Ute people of the Uinta Mountains and the country around the Strawberry River. Their homeland lay among mountain valleys and the broad basin to the east. They hunted game and used fishing and gathering places shared by Ute communities. As horses spread through the region, mounted hunters could pursue bison farther afield. In the early nineteenth century, the beaver trade brought new trading posts to rivers of the Uinta Basin.
simp_chinese: 尤维图姆人也称尤因塔阿茨人，是尤因塔山脉及斯特罗贝里河一带的尤特人。他们的家园包括山谷和东面的广阔盆地，居民狩猎，并使用尤特社群共同享有的渔场与采集地。马匹传入后，骑马的猎手能够到更远的地方追猎野牛。十九世纪初，河狸皮毛贸易又使尤因塔盆地的河边出现新的商站。

english:
Yopitzinco was the territory of the Yope on the Pacific side of the mountains of southern Mexico. Its people were related to the Me’phaa of the mountain region around Tlapa, but their coastal country retained its political independence against the expanding Mexica. The lands of Yopitzinco extended through rugged hills toward the warm coastal plain of the Costa Chica.
